text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high error rate from recent model rollout. Model alias `llama-3b-v2` promoted at 3180024665. Symptoms: garbled tokens in completions, spike in decode errors (~8x), several 5xxs from inference gateway. Impacting a subset of hosted customers. Paging oncall @alice.
alice: saw it, joining. any quick health metrics? which variant was promoted?
ben: rollout pushed weights tag `v2b-weights-2026-03-17` at 3180024665. Tokenizer alias still points to `tokenizer-v1` — looks like mismatch between weightset and tokenizer.
carol: confirmed. quick diff of promoted manifest shows `tokenizer_ref: tokenizer-v1` but weights expect `tokenizer-v2`.
alice: ok we need immediate mitigation. Recommend kill-switch the rollout flag and rollback weights. @deploy-bot can you flip `enable_llama_v2` to false?
deploy-bot: received. Flipping feature flag `enable_llama_v2` -> false. Propagation to edge configs started.
sre-ops-bot: auto-detect: traffic diversion rule activated. 95% of new requests routed to `llama-3b-v1` in 18s. Observability: error-rate trending down.
ben: starting rollback of weightset to `weights-v1-stable` across stages. command I'm running:
```
rctl promote --model llama-3b --weights weights-v1-stable --tag rollback-3180024680
```
alice: good. Carol, can you sanity-check tokenizer mapping after rollback? want to ensure no lingering alias pointing to v2.
carol: checking aliases: `tokenizer-alias/llama-3b` -> tokenizer-v1. also scanning configstore for any stale references. patching one service that had hardcoded tokenizer_ref.
deploy-bot: rollback promote started at 3180024723. progress: stage=canary done, stage=prod start.
ben: prod completed at 3180024770. Gateways show stable tokenization. Error rate back to baseline in most regions.
alice: customer impact: three customers saw degraded completions (emails queued). No data exfiltration. Ops will notify affected accounts. Estimated impact window ~3m.
carol: drafting customer note: short description, remediation done, root cause = tokenizer/weightset mismatch during artifact publish. Will include temporary mitigation and ETA for postmortem.
alice: assign postmortem to @ben and @carol. Include checklist: publishing pipeline validation, alias atomicity, automations to assert tokenizer/weights compatibility pre-promote.
jordan: taking handoff for 2nd line monitoring until midnight. temp contact if regressions show up.
alice: thanks team. Will follow up in #postmortems with timeline and initial RCA. :thumbsup:
